pNone_chapter_1: In a dimly lit room of a colonial-style Dak bungalow, Byomkesh Bakshi and Ajit Bandyopadhyay sit in wooden armchairs across from Inspector Ramani Babu. Byomkesh, dressed in a crisp white dhoti-kurta, leans forward with a sharp, contemplative gaze while holding a glowing cigarette, as the Inspector gestures expressively while recounting a tale. The evening light filters through tall windows, casting long shadows across the floor and highlighting the focused, expectant expressions of the three men. A tray with tea service sits on a low table between them, grounding the scene in a moment of quiet, intellectual tension.
